column2: Diabetes is a chronic disease in which blood sugar levels become too high.
Hypertension is another name for high blood pressure.
Fever is commonly caused by infections or inflammation.
Insulin is a hormone that helps regulate blood sugar.
Asthma is a condition that affects the airways and can make breathing difficult.
Cancer is a group of diseases in which abnormal cells grow uncontrollably and may spread to other parts of the body.
Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs and may cause cough, fever, and difficulty breathing.
Migraine is a neurological condition that can cause severe headache and other symptoms.
